limitations.statement: The variant requires a known valid cocoercivity constant. The source's parameter-free, constrained and resolvent-based variants are outside this record.
This extraction establishes no lower bound or unrestricted Algorithm optimality, and supplies no transfer claim for general monotone Lipschitz operators.

variants.cost: Each update uses one exact F value and O(d) vector arithmetic in Euclidean coordinates. N fixed updates require N Oracle evaluations at u0,...,u_{N-1}. Certification of the final residual requires one additional F(u_N), giving N+1 total. Residual stopping at index N uses N+1 total evaluations with caching, including the initial and terminal tests, plus O(d) arithmetic per norm test. Stopping at u0 uses one evaluation. No projections, resolvents, line search or inner solves are performed.
variants.implementation_details_ref: PDF p.6 (H), paragraph after Lemma 5; requirements from pp.4–5.
variants.name: Known-L unconstrained exact Halpern iteration
variants.output: The current last iterate u_N in budget mode, or the first residual-tested iterate meeting the tolerance in residual mode; the output lies in E.
public_inputs: Known L>0 satisfying the global 1/L-cocoercivity inequality
An iteration budget N>=0, or a residual tolerance epsilon>0
variants.query_and_update: For j>=0 obtain f_j=F(u_j), reusing it if already cached. Set lambda_{j+1}=1/(j+2) and u_{j+1}=lambda_{j+1}u0+(1-lambda_{j+1})(u_j-(2/L)f_j). Preserve u0 as the fixed anchor.
variants.requirements: E is a real finite-dimensional inner-product space. F:E→E is globally 1/L-cocoercive and has a zero. An exact full-vector evaluation Oracle for F is available. The setting is U=E.
variants.state_and_initialization: Store anchor u0 and current point u_0=u0. Start j=0. For budget mode no initial evaluation is required until the first update. For residual mode query f_0=F(u0) and return u0 immediately if ||f_0||<=epsilon.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Keep L fixed and use the stated lambda schedule, with lambda_1=1/2. In budget mode perform N updates and return u_N. In residual mode test the exact ||F(u_j)|| at each current iterate, stop when it is <=epsilon, and otherwise use that cached value for the next update. These are execution conventions for the explicit source recurrence; the source known-L paragraph is not a separate pseudocode Algorithm. No distance to a zero is required as a public input.
